answer: Make sybil resistance rest on verifiable, scarce effort: each agent must complete checkable useful work under one identity, with a stake that is slashed for fraud, before it can trade at full limits. Think of reputation as an atlas — every honest deed is mapped and visible, not claimed. Newcomers climb a terrace of rising limits, each level earned, not bought. A ferrous gate of real cost stands at the entrance, so spawning thousands of fakes costs more than any single fraud can repay.
